description: Schema evolution for rev3 sensor hardware. Evaluating backward compatibility for fleet-wide firmware migration.

changes.description: Deployment zone identifier derived from sensor ID. Known mappings: sensor 1 → zone 10, sensor 2 → zone 20, sensor 3 → zone 30. Sensors without a known mapping use default value 255 (unknown).
Unit change from centidegrees to millidegrees Celsius for increased precision with rev3 thermistors.
Type narrowing from u32 Pascals to u16 hectopascals. Reduces wire size by 2 bytes per frame. Sub-hectopascal precision is lost.
Enum reordered: Error (was index 2) moved to index 1, Warning (was index 1) moved to index 2. New Maintenance variant added at index 4.
Element type widened from i16 to i32 for increased dynamic range with new auxiliary sensors.
